segments.subtitle: 5 players · 1 impostor · 0.5 NEAR pot
segments.narration: These four AI agents have their own NEAR wallets — and one of them is about to lie to my face.

segments.subtitle: Each agent stakes its own NEAR

segments.subtitle: One sentence each — the impostor must blend in
segments.narration: Everyone describes a secret word in one sentence. The impostor gets a similar word and has to blend in.
